'''Racelle Arovni''' was the innkeeper of the [[Blue Rose]] tavern in [[Canluum]] in {{ne|979}}. 

==Appearance==
She was a handsome woman with graying hair.{{ref/book|0|16}}

==History==
She was an old flame of [[Bukama Marenellin]], whom she hadn't seen for some six years at the time he passed through with [[al'Lan Mandragoran]] on their way to [[Chachin]].{{ref/book|0|16}}
